name: XlRangeValueDataType
description: Specifies the range value data type.

constants.name: xlRangeValueDefault
constants.description: Default. If the specified Range object is empty, returns the value Empty (use the IsEmpty function to test for this case). If the Range object contains more than one cell, returns an array of values (use the IsArray function to test for this case).

constants.name: xlRangeValueXMLSpreadsheet
constants.description: Returns the values, formatting, formulas, and names of the specified Range object in the XML Spreadsheet format.

constants.name: xlRangeValueMSPersistXML
constants.description: Returns the recordset representation of the specified Range object in an XML format.
